senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.נֵס Iflag, sign, miraculous event.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 25:8">Targ. Y. Num. XXV, 8</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Pes. V, 32ᶜ bot. <he>נסא הוה רב</he> a great event (delivery from danger) had occurred; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:11:5">Y. Taan. III, end, 67ᵃ</cite> <he>ניסא</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 54a:11">Ber. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ דרבים</he> a providential event which concerns the community, opp. <he>נ׳ דיחיד</he>.

<cite ref="Megillah 3b:10">Meg. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>משום פרסומי נ׳</he> because it is a duty to proclaim the wonderful event (in the Book of Esther); <cite ref="Shabbat 23b:3">Sabb. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>פרסומי נ׳</he> to proclaim the wonderful events (of the Maccabean days, by lighting the candles); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>נִסִּין</he>, <cite ref="N00928"><he>נִסַּיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00927"><he>נִסֵּי</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01772"><he>נִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 21:14">Targ. Y. II, Num. XXI, 14</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46ᶜ.

<cite ref="Yoma 21a:9">Yoma 21ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ דגואי</he> wonders which happened within the Temple; <he>נ׳ דבראי</he> outside of the Temple. Ib.ᵇ <he>נ׳ דקביעי</he> permanent, regularly recurring wonders; a. fr.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 15:25">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XV, 25</cite>.—Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 55ᶜ (oneirocritical play on <cite ref="N00711"><he>נִיסַן</he></cite>) <he>וניסין לית את חמי</he> and thou shalt experience no trials; (<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>רבתי נִסְיוֹנִין</he> (<he>חד מתלמ׳</he>); <cite ref="Berakhot 56b:3">Ber. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא אתית לידי נסיון</he>).
